div.div:
OCP: implemented by constructor references
RegularCustomer::new, VIPCustomer::new,
CriticCustomer::new in ArrivalSchedule -
a new customer type needs no switch / type check.

div.div:
DIP: the engine depends on the GameUI and
FoodChoiceStrategy interfaces; tests plug in
ScriptedUI / GreedyUI / FixedFoodChoice.
Rules stay in domain; UI only reads and prints.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 303px; height: 1px; padding-top: 10000px; margin-left: 10000px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #333333;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#333333, #c1c1c1); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Polymorphism (abstract class + hooks)
Overridden per type, no instanceof anywhere:
getSatisfactionLossPerTurn(): 8 / 5 / 12
calculateBill(): VIPCustomer -10%
chooseDish(): CriticCustomer orders the most
expensive item (its order preference)
Encapsulation: all state is private; mutators are
package-private (~) and called only by staff / Restaurant
after checking the rules (requireStatus()).

div.div:
Encapsulation: priceCents is final and set in the
constructor = price locked when the order is taken.
Constructor is package-private: only Waiter creates orders.

div.div:
SRP / OCP: the one place a bill is computed:
customer.calculateBill() first (VIP), then every
active Promotion (Happy Hour -20%).
VIP Burger in HH: 1500 x0.9 x0.8 = 1080 cents

div.div:
Composition: Restaurant creates and owns
its Tables, its staff and PricingPolicy
(Host / HappyHour only if the stage enables them).
Customers and Menu are shared (aggregation).

div.div:
Inheritance + composition: a ComboMeal IS-A
MenuItem made of two MenuItems; price = 90% of the
sum, units = sum. Order / Chef use it unchanged (LSP).
